body:
Logan Wright: looping in SRE for a quick review on onboarding telemetry + alerting thresholds before we expand beta cohort. We’ve got Console + backend emitting `onboarding.*` events (schema v1) and dashboards, but want to make sure alerts won’t be noisy / won’t miss real outages.

Logan Wright: current plan:
- metrics from collector -> kafka -> stream proc -> warehouse
- alert on “missing events” and “late events”

Logan Wright: Qs:
1) what’s a sane threshold for missing events (absolute vs % drop) given traffic varies a lot by hour?
2) what’s “late” for this pipeline? we have some steps computed async (ex: first_successful_request validator from gateway metrics)

Dylan Brooks: +1. also note: Console checklist is behind feature flag + cohort targeting. traffic will ramp non-linearly.

Nadia Rahman: for context, events we rely on for checklist validation/funnel:
- `onboarding.checklist_viewed`
- `onboarding.step_completed` (manual)
- `onboarding.step_validated` (server-side / async)
- `onboarding.api_key_created` (backend)
- `onboarding.first_successful_request_detected` (validator)
- `onboarding.first_streaming_session_detected` (validator)

Nadia Rahman: all events have `event_id` + `dedupe_key`, and we’re enforcing property allowlist + “no prompt content” constraint.

Mei Lin: from analytics side, for funnel we can tolerate some lag, but if the pipeline is down we won’t know completion rate drop-off until the next day unless we have real-time alerts.

Amara Diallo: gateway metrics -> validator job: we’re expecting 2-5 min typical. could be 10-15 min worst-case during deploys / metric backfill.

Chloe Martin: backend state updates are synchronous, but the “validator” is scheduled (every ~2 min) + reads aggregated metrics. so “late” isn’t necessarily “broken”.

Logan Wright: makes sense. SRE recommendation?

Datadog Bot: Monitor suggestion: anomaly detected in `onboarding_events_ingested_total` (region=us-east-1) compared to last 1h baseline.

Dylan Brooks: (ignore that, we’re doing load tests in staging right now :facepalm:)

PagerDuty Bot: Reminder: Quiet hours enabled for low-urgency alerts in #eng-sre (22:00-06:00 local).

Logan Wright: lol ok. back to prod thresholds.

Nadia Rahman: metrics we have right now:
- `onboarding_events_emitted_total{source=console|backend, env, region}`
- `onboarding_events_accepted_total{collector, env, region}`
- `onboarding_events_processed_total{job=streamproc, env, region}`
- `onboarding_events_to_warehouse_total{env, region}`
- `onboarding_event_lag_seconds{p50,p90,p99, env, region}` computed as (warehouse_ingest_ts - event_client_ts) for console, and (warehouse_ingest_ts - server_ts) for backend
- `onboarding_streamproc_dlq_messages` for poison pills

Leila Farouk: QA note: client_ts can be skewed (user laptop). we shouldn’t page on lag using client timestamps.

Chloe Martin: +1. server_ts exists for backend events, but console events only have client_ts.

Logan Wright: we can change collector to stamp receive_ts and use that for lag.

Nadia Rahman: we already add `collector_received_ts` at ingress. we can compute lag off that, per event type.

Logan Wright: perfect.

Logan Wright: proposal from SRE lens:
A) PIPELINE HEALTH (paging)
- alert on drop in `onboarding_events_accepted_total` relative to expected request volume, per region
- alert on DLQ growth
- alert on end-to-end lag from collector_received_ts -> warehouse

Logan Wright: B) PRODUCT FUNNEL (non-paging)
- anomaly on `onboarding.step_validated` volumes, but notify-only since cohort/ramp can change

Mei Lin: yes please separate those. funnel alerts paging will be chaos during rollout.

Dylan Brooks: what do you mean by “relative to expected request volume”?

Logan Wright: correlate against Console pageviews / API traffic. something like:
- compute ratio: `accepted_onboarding_events / console_pageviews` (or `console_sessions`)
- page if ratio drops >40% for 15 min AND pageviews > some floor.

Chloe Martin: we do have `console_route_view_total{route=/onboarding}` and also general `console_pageview_total`.

Nadia Rahman: but onboarding checklist can be viewed from multiple routes (home, project overview card, etc). so “/onboarding” only isn’t enough.

Dylan Brooks: we can use `onboarding.checklist_viewed` itself as the denominator? (lol circular)

Logan Wright: yeah not that.

Logan Wright: simplest: use `console_pageview_total` as denominator + floor. or just alert on absolute drop with a floor.

Logan Wright: concrete thresholds I’d recommend (initial, adjust after beta week):
1) Missing events (paging):
- condition: `sum(rate(onboarding_events_accepted_total[5m]))` drops >60% vs 1h rolling baseline
- AND `sum(rate(console_pageview_total[5m])) > 2/sec` (traffic floor)
- AND lasts 10-15 min
- scoped per region + global

Logan Wright: 2) Stream processor stuck (paging):
- `onboarding_event_lag_seconds_p95` (based on collector_received_ts) > 300s for 10 min
- OR `onboarding_events_processed_total` not increasing for 10 min while accepted_total is increasing

Logan Wright: 3) DLQ / poison pill (paging if sustained):
- `onboarding_streamproc_dlq_messages` increasing for >10 min OR DLQ depth > 1000
- link runbook: “sample DLQ messages, check schema version mismatch, rollback streamproc deploy”

Logan Wright: 4) Warehouse delay (non-paging at first):
- `warehouse_ingest_lag_p95` > 15m for 30m (notify-only)

Mei Lin: +1 on warehouse being notify. warehouse delays happen and paging won’t help.

Amara Diallo: what about the validator jobs? first_success/streaming signals will naturally be behind.

Logan Wright: validator-specific alert should be distinct:
- page ONLY if validator queue / schedule stops (e.g., heartbeat missing)
- do NOT page on “no first_successful_request_detected” volume drop during cohort changes

Chloe Martin: we have a cron heartbeat metric: `onboarding_validator_last_success_unixts{validator=first_success}`

Nadia Rahman: we can add alert: now - last_success > 10m => page.

Leila Farouk: also please don’t alert on “late” for validator unless it’s >30m. during load tests we saw 12-18m backfill when gateway metrics were delayed.

Dylan Brooks: makes sense.

Mei Lin: can we add a warning to the dashboard that step validations are async and can lag by ~15m? otherwise PMs will think it’s broken.

Nadia Rahman: yep I can add annotation + in-console microcopy “may take a few minutes to update”.

Logan Wright: action items:
- Nadia: update lag metric to use `collector_received_ts` and adjust dashboards
- Chloe/Dylan: wire alerts above into DD monitors (paging vs notify) + add runbook links
- Amara: confirm expected worst-case lag for gateway metrics per region (so we don’t mis-tune validator heartbeat)
- Mei: add “expected lag” note + make sure funnel dashboards use event_time vs ingest_time consistently

Dylan Brooks: :thumbsup: will open a ticket for monitors + runbook update.

Chloe Martin: same, I’ll add validator heartbeat alert. current cron is every 2m, so page at 10m seems reasonable.

Amara Diallo: will reply w/ metric delay numbers. us-west tends to be the worst during deploys.

Mei Lin: thanks. once alerts are in, I’ll do a dry run during the next beta ramp.

Logan Wright: cool. please also tag SRE on the beta go/no-go thread so we’re watching monitors during rollout.
